text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that Tracen Academy students were helping
with the summer festival, I decided to go check
on how things were going.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hear the flutes and drums go pii-hyara don-don,
and an Edo-born Umamusume's blood starts pumping!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, Kitasan!
How are things looking on your end?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Okay! I've set up the Bon Odori tower!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All good on our end too!
Sound and lighting are both fully operational!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Coming up! Good work, you two! Looks like everything's all set now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Turbo.
Take the allowance money we got.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Food stall meal tickets?!
Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
They say you shouldn't let money sit overnight.
Let's blow it all tonight and—

text_block_list.name: Festival Official
text_block_list.text:
Huh, threw their back out!?
Teacher can't make it to the venue!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?
Did someone hurt you?

text_block_list.name: Festival Official
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the singing teacher who was
scheduled to sing atop the yagura scaffold
at today's Bon Odori can't make it...

text_block_list.name: Festival Official
text_block_list.text:
What should I do about the music...?
Maybe perform without singing...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... And after I went through the trouble of getting a mic.
What a bummer...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't get your tail in a twist.
Have you forgotten who you're looking at?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. If the Great Professor isn't going to show up,
some people are bound to feel down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, the one standing right here is
an Umamusume from the world-renowned Tracen Academy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tacky or not,
I wouldn't be much of a woman if I didn't roll up my sleeves and help out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
I won't let things end in disappointment like this!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've got plenty of confidence in my vocal cords!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
SOOO FREAKIN' COOOOL!!!
Turbo wants to say something super cool toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now, isn't making a grand show
your absolute specialty?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Um... Turbo engine at full throttle!
Let's get this party crazy hyped up!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty! Come on, come on, come on!
Let's put on a flashy show!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come on up to the front, everyone!
If you're gonna watch anyway, you might as well dance!

text_block_list.name: Festival Visitor
text_block_list.text: What's going on here?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gents, boys and girls,
come on over and check it out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"We won't let it end as just another Bon dance.
The high-energy night festival begins now!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later—cheerful festival music
and the cheers of the crowd filled the small festival grounds.
It was an energizing summer night.
